models: Audi A4 / VW Passat / Skoda Octavia
engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
commonCauses: Control Module incorrectly coded, Auto-Hold not installed
Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri/Connectors from/to Brake Light Switch (F) faulty
Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri/Connectors from/to Lamp for Auto-Hold (K237) faulty
stepByStepSolution: Kontrol edin:  Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri/Connectors from/to Brake Light Switch (F)
Kontrol edin:  Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri/Connectors and fuse(s) from/to Lamp for Auto-Hold (K237)
technicalNotes:
Bu arıza kodu şu modülde görüldüğünde: VW Passat (3C): Parking Brake
Kontrol edin:  if Auto-Hold is installed/equipped, car data plate (sticker on 1st page of the service manual or identical sticker in the trunk) should have a UH2 tag and Parking Brake Control Module Coding accordingly. After Coding make sure to Cycle the Ignition and leave it OFF for at least 30 Seconds.
Kontrol edin:  Brake Light Switch (F) Signal via Parking Brake Control Module Measuring Value Block (MVB) 003.1
Gerçekleştirin: Selective Output Test (in Parking Brake Control Module)
